info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Graduate Institute of Financial and Economic Law (Jurisprudence)

description.describe_ch: 公司法的規範和公司制度的發展皆為與時俱進。當公司由小公司轉變成為大公司時，不僅股東的本質產生重大的改變，股東的組成與公司經營結構也產生了重大變化。因此為了進一步瞭解公司經營者、公司股東，和公司利害關係人相互間的權利義務關係與利益可能的衝突。對於公司治理的完整探討也就成為是否能平衡且兼顧及各方利益的關鍵。因此公司治理的研究實屬不可或缺的課程。
description.describe_eh: As corporation law evolves, so does the form of the corporation.  When a corporation transforms from a private, closely-held one to a public one, the transformation dramatically alters the nature and composition of shareholders and management. To understand this transformation and related issues of managerial accountability and shareholder's and stakeholder's interests, students examine corporate governance and the key to the balance of management flexibility and management accountability.
